entries.title: Wave 4 governance metadata baseline
entries.summary: Established the public-safe Corpus governance and asset metadata projection layer.

entries.title: ERRATUM-001: Book I, Chapter 27; Definition I.D19a; Theorem I.T05
entries.summary: Corrects the published prime-polarity definition. The original growth-comparison clauses do not partition the primes; the corrected classifier uses the Legendre symbol (2/p), aligning Book I with the Book III bipolar classifier.

entries.title: ERRATUM-002: Book III, Chapter 18; Definition III.D23; Theorem III.T13
entries.summary: Corrects the Jacobi-symbol convention used in the internal bipolar classifier derivation. Under the classical Jacobi convention, zero factors do not reduce to a single Legendre factor.

entries.title: ERRATUM-003: Book I, Chapter 24; Theorem I.T04
entries.summary: Tightens the Hyperfactorization Theorem statement. Conditions (i)-(iii) alone do not uniquely specify the ABCD tuple; maximal tetration height must be part of the admissibility condition.

entries.title: ERRATUM-004: Panta Rhei Conspectus v1.1 PDF; TauLib trust-budget disclosure
entries.summary: Corrects the Conspectus PDF's pre-refactor TauLib trust-budget language. The downloadable v1.1 PDF still describes the interim peer-review state; the pinned public TauLib release has since landed the refactor.
